empty: Select a control on the canvas to edit its layout, visibility and display binding.
subtitle: Every field below welds to this control by its derived name.
nameHint: The derived full name and naming contract update after save
spriteHint: References an existing sprite name; M1 has no image upload.
visibleTooltip: Control-level visibility: the control shows only while this trigger holds, re-evaluated on every UI refresh. On export it's wrapped into a triggers block — with an auto-generated key, so you never hand-write it.
lintUnknownToken: is not a known trigger/effect token
frameVarHint: Multi-frame sprites pick their frame from the variable: value N shows frame N.
imageExprHint: Bracketed dispatch evaluated at runtime to swap the image, e.g. a per-ruler portrait.
wizardHint: Appends [?var|fmt] to the end of the EN copy; paste it where it belongs in other language tabs.
spriteHintButton: Empty = vanilla default GFX_button_261x34 (a visible standard button base).
spriteHintContainer: The container's background, stretched over its size; empty = no background, a group only.
clickEnabledTooltip: The button is grayed out while this trigger fails: still visible, but not clickable. On export it becomes a triggers block under the derived _click_enabled key.
clickEffectTooltip: Runs when the player clicks the button: costs, variable changes, firing events. On export it becomes an effects block under the derived _click key.
buttonTooltipEmptyHint: Empty = no pdx_tooltip line is exported.
scrollHint: When its components run past its height, the game shows a scrollbar on the right and the mouse wheel scrolls them.
listArrayHint: Name an array variable and this container becomes a list: the game makes one row for each element of the array, and the components here are one row. In a row, [?v] shows the element and [?i] its index; click effects and bindings can use v and i.
listScopeLabel: Each row in its element's scope
listScopeHint: Tick when the array holds countries or states, so a row can use [This.GetName] and the like.
